The problem

Transferring orders, creating invoices, checking stock, sorting requests. The same manual steps every day, and each one costs time and invites mistakes. Automations solve this, but only as long as they are maintained.

Services

Less manual work. More calm.

From the first check to ongoing care – all from one source.

  • New automations

    We connect your shop, marketplace, spreadsheets, email and AI services into workflows that run without manual work.

  • Automation check

    To get started: we review your workflows and show you what can be automated and how much time that saves. Fixed price, credited when you place an order.

    Request a check →

  • Amazon automations

    From our own experience as Amazon sellers: reports, stock and reviews under control, without clicking through Seller Central every day.

    • Sales reports
    • Low-stock alerts
    • Review alerts

  • AI for content and customer service

    Create product texts and translate them for more marketplaces, draft replies to customer enquiries, analyse reviews.

    • Product texts
    • Translations
    • Reply drafts

  • Repair and optimisation

    We review, repair and secure unreliable Make scenarios – and rebuild them to use fewer operations, which lowers your costs.

  • Ongoing care

    We monitor your automations and fix errors before they cost you revenue.

About us

4ELEMENTS is an automation studio based in Berlin, founded by Haydar Hinisli, who has run an Amazon brand as an online retailer since 2021. That is why we know the workflows we automate from day-to-day business, not from theory.
